commands:
cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Pre-commit hook to run mypy type-checking on all Python files in src/

echo "Running mypy type-checking on src/ directory..."

# Find all Python files in src/
PYTHON_FILES=$(find src -name "*.py" -type f)

# Run mypy with settings from pyproject.toml
if ! mypy $PYTHON_FILES; then
    echo "❌ mypy type-checking failed. Commit blocked."
    exit 1
fi

echo "✅ mypy type-checking passed."
exit 0
EOF

cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Pre-commit hook to run mypy type-checking on src/ directory

echo "Running mypy type-checking on src/ directory..."

# Run mypy with settings from pyproject.toml on the entire src package
if ! mypy src/; then
    echo "❌ mypy type-checking failed. Commit blocked."
    exit 1
fi

echo "✅ mypy type-checking passed."
exit 0
EOF
pip list | grep -E "(mypy|types|stubs)" || echo "No type packages found"
echo "# Test" >> src/test_file.py && git add src/test_file.py
git commit -m "test: verify pre-commit hook blocks commits"
git reset HEAD src/test_file.py && rm src/test_file.py

echo "=== Summary ===" && echo "1. Created src/py.typed:" && ls -la src/py.typed && echo -e "\n2. Pre-commit hook installed:" && ls -l .git/hooks/pre-commit && echo -e "\n3. Git log:" && git log -1 --oneline
